Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

PTR - subject to change before Season 15 launches; every claim here is 3.2.0 test-build data and must be re-verified at launch. [ptr] The class's carried-forward build, geared for the possibility that 3.2.0 breaks it. The PTR does three things to Sorcerer: the core stat scalar rises from 1.25 to 1.625, Ball Lightning is made playable again, and Fire builds are cut hard with Firewall and Pyromancy named specifically - and on top of that the Elemental Constellation legendary node is halved, which is the node the base build carries on its weapon. Two of the three hits land directly on this build. This variant does not pretend otherwise. It keeps the Firewall shell, because it is the only Sorcerer build this repo has a full gear model for, but it moves the weapon aspect off Elemental Constellation, stops treating the Ring of Fire as the only place damage happens, and puts Ball Lightning on the push bar. The class reads C on one 3.2.0 aggregator list and B on the other, and neither of them is confident. If a real 3.2.0 Ball Lightning guide appears before Season 15 launches, it will almost certainly be a better build than this page.

Rotation
  1. Stagger the Frost and Pyromancy procs onto a two-second cadence so a Ring of Fire is always underfoot, with Charged Bolts generating, Ice Armor and Unstable Currents kept up, and Teleport to reposition.
Variants

Leveling — [ptr] Unchanged from the base build. On the PTR Mrak hands you level 70, so this stage is for a live Season 15.
Move on when Level 70, Torment 1, Vision of the Firestorm.

Early Endgame — [ptr] Berú of the Threefold auto-casts Meteor, Blizzard and Ball Lightning; stagger the Frost and Pyromancy procs onto a two-second cadence so a Ring of Fire is always underfoot. The Shock proc fires every six seconds and cannot be steered.
Move on when Raiment of the Infinite and Drognan's Anguish equipped.

Late Endgame — [ptr] Same cadence as the early endgame.
Move on when [ptr] Glyphs at 100 and a decision made about whether Firewall is still carrying this character on 3.2.0 numbers.

Pushing — [ptr] Untested on 3.2.0 by definition. The honest expectation is that this build is worse than it was on live and that the hedge only reduces how much worse. Re-verify everything at launch.

Lootfilter

Firewall Sorcerer - Maxroll Light / Medium / Strict (in-guide import codes) — View Filter

maxroll.gg

[ptr] No Season 15 filter exists - InfinityBuilds' directory is entirely Season 14 or earlier as of 2026-08-09 - so this is the Season 14 in-guide code used as a floor. Use the Light tier here rather than Strict: this variant is hedging toward Shock and a Fire-tuned strict filter will hide the Ball Lightning affixes it wants.

Uniques
  • helm [ptr] PTR route: Mrak's boosts. Live route: Grigoire, The Galvanic Saint, Hall of the Penitent south of Ked Bardu, Dry Steppes; 1x Lair Key from Helltide. Where →
  • chest [ptr] PTR route: Mrak's boosts. Live route: Bartuc, via Infernal Hordes in Kehjistan near the Yshari Sanctum waypoint; 1x Infernal Hordes Compass, 666 Burning Aether. Where →
  • ring 2 [ptr] PTR route: Mrak's boosts. Live route: Andariel, Hanged Man's Hall east of Tarsarak, Kehjistan; 1x Greater Lair Key. Where →
  • pants [ptr] PTR route: Mrak's boosts. Live route: General Unique Pool from any lair boss, plus vendor gambling on pants. Where →

How to run them

[ptr] Carried over from Season 14 unchanged: the official 3.2.0 notes do not mention mercenaries at all, so the Season 14 pairing is the only guidance in existence. Identical across all five of the guide's variants: hire Subo 'for maphack and Molotov Scorched Earth spam', reinforce with Raheir 'with Bastion on Injured for safety'. The Molotov pick is coherent rather than incidental - more Burning application on top of a Firewall DoT engine - and the maphack directly answers the build's own named weakness, that it cannot go fast. Icy Veins hires Varyana instead but agrees on Raheir and Bastion; its Sorcerer page is dated Season 9 / patch 2.3.0 and describes a completely different Firewall build, so that divergence is staleness rather than a live disagreement and Maxroll's Subo is what this build records.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

PTR - subject to change before Season 15 launches; every claim here is 3.2.0 test-build data and must be re-verified at launch. [ptr] The class's carried-forward build, geared for the possibility that 3.2.0 breaks it. The PTR does three things to Sorcerer: the core stat scalar rises from 1.25 to 1.625, Ball Lightning is made playable again, and Fire builds are cut hard with Firewall and Pyromancy named specifically - and on top of that the Elemental Constellation legendary node is halved, which is the node the base build carries on its weapon. Two of the three hits land directly on this build. This variant does not pretend otherwise. It keeps the Firewall shell, because it is the only Sorcerer build this repo has a full gear model for, but it moves the weapon aspect off Elemental Constellation, stops treating the Ring of Fire as the only place damage happens, and puts Ball Lightning on the push bar. The class reads C on one 3.2.0 aggregator list and B on the other, and neither of them is confident. If a real 3.2.0 Ball Lightning guide appears before Season 15 launches, it will almost certainly be a better build than this page.

Rotation
  1. Stagger the Frost and Pyromancy procs onto a two-second cadence so a Ring of Fire is always underfoot, with Charged Bolts generating, Ice Armor and Unstable Currents kept up, and Teleport to reposition.
Variants

Leveling — [ptr] Unchanged from the base build. On the PTR Mrak hands you level 70, so this stage is for a live Season 15.
Move on when Level 70, Torment 1, Vision of the Firestorm.

Early Endgame — [ptr] Berú of the Threefold auto-casts Meteor, Blizzard and Ball Lightning; stagger the Frost and Pyromancy procs onto a two-second cadence so a Ring of Fire is always underfoot. The Shock proc fires every six seconds and cannot be steered.
Move on when Raiment of the Infinite and Drognan's Anguish equipped.

Late Endgame — [ptr] Same cadence as the early endgame.
Move on when [ptr] Glyphs at 100 and a decision made about whether Firewall is still carrying this character on 3.2.0 numbers.

Pushing — [ptr] Untested on 3.2.0 by definition. The honest expectation is that this build is worse than it was on live and that the hedge only reduces how much worse. Re-verify everything at launch.

Reasoning

Based onRing of Fire Firewall Sorcerer
Tweaks vs. the base build
  1. [ptr] Aspect of Elemental Constellation comes off the weapon at every endgame stage. 3.2.0 halves the Elemental Constellation legendary node, and a halved multiplier on the build's single most contested slot is not worth defending. Aspect of Combustion takes the slot instead.
  2. [ptr] Ball Lightning replaces Hydra on the push bar. The official notes say Ball Lightning was made playable again in the same patch that cut Fire - so on this patch the Shock half of the tree is the half with upside, and this build already invests in it for the Berú of the Threefold procs.
  3. [ptr] Intelligence rises in the priority order on the helm, amulet and weapon. The +30% core-stat scalar (1.25 to 1.625) is the one unambiguous gain in the patch and it is element-agnostic, which makes it the safest thing on the page to gear for.
  4. [ptr] Cooldown reduction is kept rather than sacrificed. The Season 14 push variant's Berú of the Cauldron package makes cooldown reduction actively reduce Firewall damage; with Firewall cut on this patch, buying more of a nerfed skill's damage at the price of every cooldown on the bar is the wrong trade.
  5. [ptr] Soul Splinter: this build's damage is Firewall's damage over time, but its procs and its Ball Lightning hedge both crit, so Splinter of Hellfire's -100% Critical Strike Chance is not safe here despite the build looking DoT-shaped. Splinter of Anguish is the consistent pick; the digest's own read is that any crit-scaling build must take Anguish and only a genuinely non-crit build can take Hellfire.
  6. [ptr] No War Plans, on either page - 3.2.0 changes nothing about the system and no per-build picks exist for any season.

Charged Bolts becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals Fire damage, and costs 30 Mana.

Each bolt no longer pierces and instead releases 2 to 3 explosions on impact, dealing an additional 180% damage.

Overload

UpgradeCharged Bolts

Casting Charged Bolts now also discharges Crackling Energy in an electric wave, dealing its damage to all enemies caught in it.

Crackling Energy will no longer automatically pulse its last 3 charges.

Chain of Cold

UpgradeChain Lightning

Chain Lightning becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.

Chain Lightning Chills by 25% and deals up to 100%[x] increased damage based on how Chilled the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are Frozen.

Chain Whipping

UpgradeChain Lightning

Chain Lightning gains 20%[+] Cast Speed and its number of chains is doubled.

Critical Strike Chance

UpgradeChain Lightning

Chain Lightning forms a Crackling Energy whenever it Critically Strikes.

Chain Lightning gains 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance.

Ramping Damage

UpgradeChain Lightning

Every Second, Chain Lightning gains 5%[x] damage, up to 25%[x]. This bonus is reset when you damage an enemy with a Skill Cast other than Chain Lightning.

Damage Bonus

UpgradeChain Lightning

Chain Lightning deals 100%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit.

Thunderbolt

UpgradeIce Shards

Ice Shards becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage.

Ice Shards launches a large thunderbolt that explodes on impact into 5 smaller seeking thunderbolt shards, dealing 33% damage each.

Glacial Spike

UpgradeIce Shards

Ice Shards combines all shards into a massive spike, dealing 10%[x] increased damage per shard. The spike explodes on impact and Chills for 50%.

Piercing Cold

UpgradeIce Shards

Ice Shards will pierce 1 additional time.

Ice Shards will additionally pierce up to 3 Vulnerable enemies.

Pierce Damage Bonus

UpgradeIce Shards

Ice Shards deals 20%[x] increased damage after piercing once.

Hit Damage Bonus

UpgradeIce Shards

Ice Shards deals 10%[x] increased damage to an enemy each time it hits them in the same cast.

Barrier

UpgradeIce Shards

Ice Shards launches 1 additional shard while you have a Barrier.

Cost Reduction

UpgradeIce Shards

Ice Shards' Mana cost is reduced by 3.

Duration Bonus

UpgradeFlame Shield

Flame Shield's duration is increased to 1.5 seconds.

Scorch

UpgradeFlame Shield

Flame Shield instantly scorches close enemies, dealing 14% damage and Immobilizing them for 3 seconds.

Cooldown Reduction

UpgradeFlame Shield

Flame Shield's Cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

Healing

UpgradeFlame Shield

While Flame Shield is active, you heal for 12% of your Maximum Life ({x}) per second.

Overpower

UpgradeFlame Shield

Flame Shield grants 1 stack of Overpower.

Flash

UpgradeFlame Shield

Flame Shield becomes a Shock Skill, deals Sparking damage, and triggers its Cooldown on Cast.

Instead of becoming Immune you embody lightning, generating 4 Crackling Energy per second and gaining 35% Movement Speed and 15.0% Dodge.

Firebird

UpgradeFlame Shield

Flame Shield rains down {x} Meteorites per second that deal 8.5% damage.

Wormhole

UpgradeTeleport

Teleport Stuns enemies hit for 0.50 seconds, and there is a 2 second window where you can cast Teleport again.

Electrobolt

UpgradeTeleport

Teleport pulls in all Close Crackling Energy and reduces the Cooldown of the next Teleport by 0.30 seconds per Crackling Energy gained this way.

Crackling Energy

UpgradeTeleport

Teleport forms 2 Crackling Energy at the ending location.

Weaken

UpgradeTeleport

Teleport Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

Resource Regeneration

UpgradeIce Armor

Ice Armor grants 5 Mana Regeneration while active.

Blast Chill

UpgradeIce Armor

Ice Armor also applies to Nearby Allies and increases All Resistances by 10%.

Razor Ice

UpgradeIce Armor

Ice Armor forms {x} Ice Spikes per second under Close enemies that deal 25% damage.

Frozen and Chill

UpgradeIce Armor

Close enemies that attack you while Ice Armor is active will be Frozen or Chilled for 10%.

Freezing Mist

UpgradeFrost Nova

Instead of Freezing, Frost Nova forms an aura of frigid mist around you that deals 175% Frostbite damage over 4 seconds.

Vulnerable

UpgradeFrost Nova

Frost Nova makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

Size Bonus

UpgradeFrost Nova

Frost Nova's Size is increased by 50%.

Cold Front

UpgradeFrost Nova

Frost Nova is now cast at a target location, and each enemy Frozen by it reduces the cooldowns of your Frost Skills by 0.5 seconds.

Shatter

UpgradeFrost Nova

Enemies that die while Frozen by Frost Nova have a 100% chance to unleash an additional Frost Nova.

Resource Generation

UpgradeFrost Nova

Each enemy Frozen by Frost Nova generates 5 Mana.

Charge

UpgradeFrost Nova

Frost Nova gains 1 additional Charge, but its Cooldown is increased by 6 seconds.

Charge

UpgradeFamiliar

Familiar gains 1 additional Charge.

Size Bonus

UpgradeFamiliar

Familiar's explosion radius is increased by 50%.

Duration Bonus

UpgradeFamiliar

Familiar's duration is increased by 4 seconds.

Healing Flames

UpgradeFamiliar

Casting Familiar grants 1 stack of Overpower and restores 1.0% of your Maximum Life ({x}) per second while active.

Bonus Effect

UpgradeFamiliar

Gain a bonus based on the Familiar type when the Familiar explodes:

Fire Familiar Gain +5% Healing Received for 5 seconds.

Cold Familiar Gain a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life ({x}) for 5 seconds, up to 30%.

Lightning Familiar Reduce a random active Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

Freezing Familiar

UpgradeFamiliar

Familiar becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.

Familiar Chills for 15% and Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

Fast As Lightning

UpgradeFamiliar

Familiar becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage.

Familiar increases your Minimum Ferocity by 1 and grants 2.00% Cooldown Reduction while active.

Prismatic Familiar

UpgradeFamiliar

Familiar becomes a Pyromancy, Shock, and Frost Skill that summons a stationary Prismatic Familiar.

Casting Skills will cause Prismatic Familiar to apply 105% Frostbite, Sparking, or Burning damage over 4 seconds to surrounding enemies based on the Element Cast.

Cast Speed

UpgradeHydra

Hydra gains 50% Cast Speed, but its duration is reduced to 8 seconds.

Overpower

UpgradeHydra

Hydra gains 1 head for every 3 Overpower you have on Cast.

Bathed in Flame

UpgradeHydra

Hydra is bathed in flame, dealing 28% Burning damage per second to surrounding enemies.

Hydra's attacks now instead deal 70% Burning damage over 4 seconds.

Frigid Hydra

UpgradeHydra

Hydra becomes a Frost Skill that deals 43.75% Cold damage.

Hydra's attacks pierce enemies and Chill for 15%.

Cooldown Reduction

UpgradeIce Blades

Ice Blades' Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds each time it attacks an enemy.

Blazing Blades

UpgradeIce Blades

Ice Blades becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 115% Fire damage.

Ice Blades gain 30% Cast Speed, but drain 5 Mana per attack.

Frozen Tomb

UpgradeIce Blades

Ice Blades is now cast at the target location and surrounds it with 3 Ice Blades.

Ice Blades Chill enemies for 10%, but their Movement Speed is reduced by 50%.

Ice Crack

UpgradeIce Blades

Every 3rd slash from Ice Blades is an Ice Crack, dealing 230% damage in a large cone.

Area Bonus

UpgradeIce Blades

Ice Blades now cleave.

Duration Bonus

UpgradeIce Blades

Ice Blades' duration is increased by 5 seconds.

Cast Speed

UpgradeIce Blades

Ice Blades gains 50%[+] Cast Speed when attacking Frozen enemies.

Projectile Speed

UpgradeLightning Spear

Lightning Spears move 50% faster.

Chain Reaction

UpgradeLightning Spear

Lightning Spear arcs to 2 additional surrounding targets dealing 48% damage. Critical Strikes greatly increase the range of the arcs.

Flame Spear

UpgradeLightning Spear

Lightning Spear becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals 198% Fire damage, but its Cooldown is increased by 5 seconds

Burning enemies hit by Lightning Spear explode for 120%.

Damage Bonus

UpgradeLightning Spear

Lightning Spear deals 100%[x] increased damage. This bonus is reduced by 10%[x] each time Lightning Spear deals damage to an enemy.

Exposure

UpgradeBlizzard

Blizzard's duration is increased to 6 seconds and it makes enemies Vulnerable.

Static Field

UpgradeBlizzard

Blizzard becomes a Shock Skill, deals 525% Sparking damage over 1.0 seconds, and costs 15 Mana.

Blizzard periodically Stuns enemies for 0.25 seconds.

Resource Generation

UpgradeBlizzard

Blizzard deals 3%[x] increased damage and grants 2 Mana Regeneration for each active Blizzard, up to 10 Mana.

Damage Bonus

UpgradeBlizzard

Blizzard deals 30%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

Resource Damage Bonus

UpgradeMeteor

Meteor now consumes all your remaining Mana on Cast, dealing 2%[x] increased damage for each point of extra Mana spent.

Shooting Star

UpgradeMeteor

Removes the falling delay before Meteor crashes down.

Meteor now deals 306% impact damage and 102% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

Damage and Size Bonus

UpgradeMeteor

Meteor deals 50%[x] increased damage and has 50%[x] increased Size, but now also has a 15 second Cooldown.

Comet

UpgradeMeteor

Meteor becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.

Meteor calls down an icy Comet that deals 270% damage and creates an icy mist that inflicts 66% Frostbite and 50% Chill over 3 seconds.

Wildfire

UpgradeFirewall

Firewall's Size is increased by 50% and duration increased to 7.0 seconds.

Healing

UpgradeFirewall

Firewall heals you for 0.3% of your Maximum Life ({x}) every second per affected enemy.

Every {x} Life healed by Firewall grants you 1 stack of Overpower.

Grounding

UpgradeFirewall

Firewall becomes a Shock Skill, deals 150% Sparking damage over 3.5 seconds, and costs 30 Mana.

Cost Reduction

UpgradeFirewall

Every 100 Mana spent makes your next Firewall cost no Mana, stacking up to 300 total Mana.

Ball Lightning deals 30%[x] increased damage when it hits 3 or fewer enemies.

Multiple Projectiles

UpgradeBall Lightning

Ball Lightning has a 20% chance to form a second Ball Lightning.

Attraction

UpgradeBall Lightning

Ball Lightning now deals 204% damage per second. The ball's speed is greatly increased while it is not near enemies.

Implosion

UpgradeBall Lightning

Ball Lightning becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals Fire damage, and has a 12 second Cooldown.

Ball Lightning is now cast at the target location and continuously Pulls In enemies, dealing 480% damage over 2 seconds.

Ferocity

UpgradeBall Lightning

Ball Lightning grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

Duration

UpgradeDeep Freeze

Increases the duration to 5 seconds.

Glacier

UpgradeDeep Freeze

You remain free to act during the duration and Deep Freeze now has 3 Charges.

Bonechill

Deep Freeze's continuous and final explosion damage become Frostbite damage that deals 420% and 1,440% damage over 4 seconds respectively.

This Frostbite damage Chills for 100% over 4 seconds and will remove Unstoppable from enemies.

Frigid Ward

Deep Freeze forms a Barrier that absorbs {x}(30% of Maximum Life) damage every second while active.

UpgradeDeep Freeze

Cooldown speed is increased by 50% while you have a Barrier.

Reduce Cooldown

UpgradeDeep Freeze

Reduces your Cooldowns by 1 second and generate 8 Mana every second while active.

Lifecoil

UpgradeInferno

Inferno now forms around you and follows you, healing you for 50% of your Maximum Life per second.

Pull

UpgradeInferno

Inferno continuously pulls enemies towards the center.

Overpower

UpgradeInferno

Inferno overfills your Overpower by 2 stacks.

Trip Mines

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 18 seconds

Subo scatters 3 explosive traps that each arm after 1.0 seconds. When an enemy moves within range of one, it explodes for 300% Physical damage and Knocks Down enemies for 1.5 seconds.

Cover Fire

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Subo charges a countless volley of arrows, then unleashes it over your position for 140% Physical damage that Slows enemies by 50% for 4 seconds.

Explosive Charge

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Subo fires 4 Explosive Charges that stick to enemies. Each explodes after 6.5 seconds or when their target dies, dealing 60% Physical damage.

Snipe

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Subo charges a massive piercing bolt, then unleashes it forwards for 450% Physical damage that Knocks Back enemies.

Wire Trap

Core skillSubo

Cooldown: 10 seconds

Weapon: Bow

Basic Attack: Heavy Shot

Subo places a concussive trap that arms after 0.8 seconds. When an enemy moves within range, it explodes for 80% Physical damage and Stuns enemies for 2.0 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Subo fires a toughened arrow at an enemy, dealing 80% Physical damage with a 30% chance to Stun for 1.0 seconds.

Molotov

Core skillSubo

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Crossbow

Basic Attack: Salvo

Subo tosses an incendiary at an enemy, dealing 10% Physical damage and Stunning them for 1.0 seconds before exploding into flames. For the next 5 seconds, enemies within the area repeatedly take 36% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Subo launches 5 bolts at an enemy, each dealing 30% Physical damage. The final bolt explodes, Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.
